const units = [{ id: "UP-01", name: "Unit A", cap: 4 }, { id: "UP-02", name: "Unit B", cap: 6 }];
const SCALE = 2;
function series() { return units.map(u => ({ name: u.name, count: u.cap * SCALE, r: Math.round(u.cap / 3) })); }
const rows = () => units.map((u, i) => ({ label: u.id + "#" + (i + 1), pct: (u.cap / 10 * 100).toFixed(1) }));
const caps = units.map(u => u.cap * 2);
el.innerHTML = series().map(v => '<td>' + v.count + '</td>').join('');
series().forEach(x => { el.innerHTML += '<i>' + x.r + '</i>'; });
el.innerHTML = rows().map(w => '<p>' + w.label + ' ' + w.pct).join('');
for (const v of series()) { el.innerHTML += '<b>' + v.name; }
el.innerHTML = caps.map(c => '<s>' + c.toString()).join('');
